4.6.1.message: .NET Framework 4.6.1 reached end of life, so upgrade apps to .NET Framework 4.8. In Functions v4, you can run a .NET framework 4.8 app in out-of-process mode. For more information, see the isolated process guide.
4.6.1.description: ## A migrated function app isn't starting or has some runtime issues - For .NET apps, update the code to .NET 8 (or a later supported version) before building and deploying. - Double-check the runtime version of the app in the Azure portal. - For Windows apps, set netFrameworkVersion by using CLI or PowerShell. - Make sure you're using extension bundles version 4.x, as recommended. Version 4.x of the Functions runtime requires extension bundle version 4.0.0, 5.0.0). - Logging in to Azure Storage
